mentions.title: vg30 premature bearing failure help
mentions.snippet: Single builder reports cap-side main bearings 2 and 3 failed on a Nissan VG30DETT running King XP mains, with wear on 1 and 4; the snippet gives no cause, so installation or oiling is not ruled out.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread: poster says King main thrust bearings made since 2024 have a free-spread measurement a technician judged out of spec, and advises returning them, while conceding many may have used them without problems.
